newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech c.bank repo rate unchanged at 12.4 percent.
newsitem.headline: Czech c.bank repo rate unchanged at 12.4 percent.

text.p: The Czech central bank said on Thursday that it would hold a two-week repo tender at 12.4 percent, unchanged from Wednesday.

The Prague interbank money market was watching the central bank's rate closely to see if it would ease its monetary policy in coordination with the government's pro-growth economic package announced late on Wednesday.
The central bank statement said that it would accept a maximum of two bids from each participant, at a minimum of 100 million crowns.

Late Wednesday, the government announced sweeping measures aimed at reducing growing budget and trade deficits, while spurring growth, dampening demand for imports and adding confidence to beleaguered capital markets.
It also said that while monetary policy was the central bank's area to decide, an "inverse development in monetary and fiscal policy" was needed".
